$comment: Labeled query set for the walras search evaluation harness. Each query maps corpus resource ids (eval/search/corpus.json) to graded relevance gains: 3 = the resource the query is asking for, 2 = a strong alternate answer, 1 = topically acceptable. Labels describe what an IDEAL engine should return — several queries (e.g. 'convert US dollars to euros') deliberately share no vocabulary with their target so the lexical BASELINE scores zero on them; those failures are the measured motivation for the GRANT-scope ranking upgrades (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Binary relevance for recall/MRR is gain >= 2; nDCG uses the graded gains.
